items.title: Extending LLDB to Debug Applications That Span CPUs and GPUs
items.summary: We built a vendor-neutral accelerator plugin architecture in lldb-server for debugging applications that span CPUs and GPUs. It separates shared debugger infrastructure from hardware-specific device control. The design represents the CPU and GPU as separate debugger processes while presenting them in one debugging session.
